name: Ashita Deatta Shoujo
source:
"It's summer. The place is a crater lake near the naturally ambient, rural village "Takachiho". The protagonist is standing still, blankly looking at the far-away sky.

Amnesia...
His memories of the past have been lost.
It's a strange thought, but to him on that day, the sky seems tailored to both dusk and sunrise, a mysterious color..."

The protagonist, Aisa Ryu was a freeloader in a house, living there with four beautiful sisters. Until suddenly, one day, a sad incident occurred...

[Translated from [url=http://www.moon-stone.jp/ashita/a_story.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
“夏天。地点是自然风光环绕的乡村‘高千穗’附近的一座火山口湖。主人公静静站着，茫然眺望远方的天空。

失忆……
他失去了过去的记忆。
这个想法有些奇怪，但在那一天的他眼中，天空仿佛同时属于黄昏与黎明，呈现出神秘的色彩……”

主人公相茶龙寄住在一户人家，与四位美丽姐妹共同生活。直到有一天，一场悲伤的意外突然发生……

[翻译自[url=http://www.moon-stone.jp/ashita/a_story.html]官方网站[/url]]
